title: Test whether unrestricted star-label joins transfer to the adjoining f68r2 panel
statement: Two independent image-only readers agree on 28 of 29 f68r1 star-label pairings. Nearest first-glyph points and word quadrilaterals reproduce every agreed pair. Requiring the star to be left of the word misassigns f68r1.32 and repeats a star already selected for f68r1.31.
check: Freeze a second independent, image-only pair of readers and a registered word-box set on f68r2. Carry forward the unblinding code and the three per-word rules. Report occurrences where star placement is opposite the left-only prior, nearest-rule discrepancies and the fraction independently agreed. Retain uncertainty and shared or repeated assignments without a global one-to-one constraint. Compare nearest margins before considering a wider text-picture test.

evidence.observer_setup: Two independent model readers received the same scan crop, rough overview and coordinate guides only. Each froze star centers and visual word choices before the registered boxes or each other’s selections were revealed. They are not independent scans or human readers.
main_findings: The 29 centers all have reciprocal matches and the median disagreement is 3.61 native pixels, maximum 12.65. There are 28 unique certain and concordant pairs and one mutually ambiguous word boundary at candidate f68r1.34. Both readers locate the same star and adjacent ink. Their preferred point covers different amounts of a two-group inscription, preserved separately.

On all 28 certain concordant pairs, the first-glyph and quadrilateral rules are 28 correct, zero wrong and zero unassigned. The left-only rule is 27 correct, one wrong and zero unassigned. Its f68r1.32 prediction is A24 at canvas (379, 2199), already the correct selection for f68r1.31. The other two rules select independently agreed A28 at (718, 2390). Both readers saw the f68r1.32 ink to the left of A28.

All three methods agree on f68r1.12, f68r1.26 and f68r1.30. The two different first-glyph pixels for f68r1.30 both select A20 at (1868, 1904). Among the other 25 loci, the methods gave identical correct results on all 24 with certain pairings. The remaining locus is the unresolved .34.

First-glyph and unrestricted-box minimum runner-up margins on agreed matches are 62.64 and 20.56 native pixels respectively. The data concern one physical panel and cannot estimate a general advantage of quadrilaterals where both yielded the same assignments.

plan.reader_coordinates: Crop-native x right, y down. Add 175 px in x and 60 in y to obtain Yale canvas-native coordinates.
plan.star_alignment: Match the scans by reciprocal nearest star centers between the two readers, with no exact ties and separation at most 60 native px. Report unmatched stars. This alignment does not alter either reader's label choices.
plan.word_alignment: Independently map each recorded ink-center point to the nearest published projected word quadrilateral. A point inside the box is at zero distance. A point more than 75 native px away, inside multiple boxes, or within 20 px of the next box when outside the nearest box is ambiguous. Keep all alternate choices and original uncertainty even if automatic mapping is unique.
plan.agreement_rule: A star and locus are an agreed pair when matched readers both call it certain and independently select the same unique locus. More than one agreed star for the same locus is a repeated association and is excluded from the unique agreed-pair denominator. Retain ambiguous, discordant and missing cases.
geometry_rules: Nearest reader A center to the published first-glyph point using Euclidean distance.
Nearest reader A center to the four-sided word box, with zero distance if inside.
Nearest reader A center to the same box among centers strictly left of the midpoint of the box's x span.
plan.unassignment_for_geometry: Treat exact ties and absence of an eligible center as unassigned. No distance cutoff and no global one-to-one assignment. Count repeated star choices. Retain the closest runner-up margin when nonempty.
plan.known_point_alternative: For .30 use both published and second-reader first-stroke positions reported in PR 695. For .32 list the star selected by each rule even if there is no independently agreed star.
